capabilities: Toggle inline previews of external PDF, image and video links in reading view
Convert HEIC and TIFF photos to JPEG for display on macOS via sips
Preview Google Drive file links from their local copy via Drive for desktop
Open linked files with the default app or show them in their folder
Configure which file types preview, auto-open and maximum preview height
extras: Not reviewed by Obsidian staff; desktop only (no mobile), tested on macOS, and HEIC/TIFF conversion plus Google Drive preview are macOS-only; previews work in reading view only.
problem: Obsidian opens links to files stored outside the vault in another app and cannot display them inside the note.

relations.evidence: with Google Drive for desktop, links like are previewed from the local copy

summary: Reading-view plugin that shows collapsible previews of PDFs, images and videos linked with file:// URLs from outside the vault.
